conversation.speaker: ai_agent

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So, the formation process itself shows why it's so important to think about how quickly we're using them up.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Precisely! You've grasped a key aspect of why sustainability in energy consumption is such a critical global topic.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
